name: ranxianglei/billion-context
title: ranxianglei/billion-context
headline: Billion-context plugin compresses month-long agent sessions
lede: You can keep a single session running for a month with a context compression plugin that claims a 100K window is enough and 5x token savings.

effects.effect: Longer-lived agent sessions on small windows
Compression as an alternative to bigger context windows

possibilities.title: Platform teams can bill background agent overhead to teams and test compression claims

with.title: LiteLLM unifies cost accounting for budgets and reports

possibilities.connection: Claude Code's measured 5 to 20% status summary overhead and the compression plugin's 5x savings claim are both cost claims that LiteLLM's consistent team and model spend slicing can now check against real budgets.
